plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: Thread notes in a personal knowledge vault: capture what you are thinking on the way out of a task (note), get it back on the way in (recall), link reminders to threads (remind), and sweep stale threads (prune).

plugins.name: write
plugins.description: Check and repair prose before it leaves the session: a blind subagent finds references the reader cannot resolve, an informed one replaces them and returns a change log. Also harvests detector fixtures from drafts that needed correcting.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Find and resume past agent sessions: recover and rank recent Claude Code and OpenCode terminal sessions and emit resume commands.

plugins.name: arch
plugins.description: Investigate a software system and produce a source-grounded, navigable HTML explanation of its architecture.

plugins.name: track-splitter
plugins.description: Split a long rehearsal, jam or gig recording into individual, named songs at matched loudness.
